-- IGProtocol scaffold: VINIT → AFWD → EVALT → IFIX → AFWD → EVALT → IFIX → AFWD → EVALT → IFIX → AFWD → EVALT → IFIX → TANCH
-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: four direct runs on the original method description →
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

four direct runs on the original method description → all verdict T · closure true · topology fla

phase_0.boundary_condition: the execution harness that invokes the method four times and collects the four verdicts
phase_0.domain_name: four direct runs on the original method description →
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: each run advances the harness from one verdict to the next

AREV.justification: not used; the flat chain never descends or rolls back

CLINK.justification: the four executions are composed in strict order with no branching

ENGAGR.justification: all four verdicts are uniformly T; B never arises

EVALF.justification: no run produces a negative or refuted result

EVALT.justification: each run constructively affirms the expected outcome

FFUSE.justification: without a fork there is nothing to rejoin

FSPLIT.justification: the domain has no decision points; every run follows the same linear path

IFIX.justification: each verdict T is appended irreversibly to the permanent record

IMSCRIB.justification: the method description is the same object across all four runs

TANCH.justification: all four runs have finished and the final aggregate state is sealed

VINIT.justification: no runs have been executed and no verdicts have been recorded

phase_2.rejoin_note: the domain contains no fork; the four runs form a single linear chain that closes at TANCH
phase_2.verdict_reason: No fork/fuse — void, never weighed alternatives

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held: never observed
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — constructively refuted: never observed
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — constructively proven: each run yields verdict T
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: harness before any run

steps.domain_action: harness starts with no runs executed
execute first run of the method
append first verdict T to audit log
execute second run of the method
append second verdict T to audit log
execute third run of the method
append third verdict T to audit log
execute fourth run of the method
append fourth verdict T to audit log
harness sealed after four T verdicts

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the method description itself, interpreted directly by the harness
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: none; each run is a self-contained invocation
phase_5.memory_mechanism: audit log storing the four immutable verdicts
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: sequential driver that launches runs one after another

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — each cycle adds a deterministic T verdict to an append-only log; no branching or reversal occurs
phase_6.post_cycle_state: harness with k+1 completed runs and one additional verdict T in the log
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: harness with k completed runs (0 ≤ k < 4)
